test_title: PYST 32: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The weather patterns ______ that we will have a winter season, perhaps a good one.
solution:
The correct answer is **"suggest"**.

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"suggest"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• The verb changes only in third person singular (he, she, it, a person, a thing), where it gets the suffix -s or -es.
 
• The given sentence has the plural subject i.e. patterns, so 'suggest' will be the acceptable answer.
 
• Thus, option 3) is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us see the use of 's' or 'es' in simple present tense.

 
• For the third person singular (she, he, it*), we add -s to the base form of verb.

 
 
• **Example: **He **prepares** breakfast daily.
 
 
 
• We add -es to verbs that end in -ch, -ss, -sh, -x, or -zz.
 
 
• **Example: **Buzz - Buzzes, watch - watches, Dish - Dishes, Ex - Exes, Dress - Dresses.
 
 
 
• When a verb ends in a consonant and -y, then y is changed to the I and the suffix- es is added.
 
 
• **Example: **study - studies.
 
 
 
• However, we simply add -s when the verb ends in a vowel and -y.
 
 
• **Example:** pay - pays; enjoy- enjoys
